about_the_game:
The Fantasy World Pack allows players to choose more tailored adventure experiences, with maps leaning more heavily on specific terrains.

Cross the seas with pirate-themed adventures on Pirate Isles, journey down a jungle river experience with Big River, cross the desert in Desert Crossing, journey to the far north in Rangers of the North, traverse over and under mountains in Dwarvish Roads, or fight in the ultimate urban environment in Kimble City.

Unlocking this pack enables you to host games for all players of Journey Quest, even those who have not unlocked the pack themselves.
